description.narrative: There will be 600 new rural sanitation infrastructure benefiting 600 households. There will also be some rehabilitation of the existing infrastructure in the urban areas. For the urban areas, the population benefiting from improved sanitation was conservatively estimated (10% of main towns population: Maputsoe, Mafeteng and Mohales Hoek). The data will be disaggregated by gender and youth. Source of verification: LLWSS data
